[b][size=2]﻿ [/size][size=4]                                                 Installation instructions:[/size][/b]
1. Extract the file somewhere on your machine (not in the Mods folder).
2. After extracting you will see a folder called ''Portrait of Mike'', inside the folder there are 2 pictures ''Mike'' and ''Mike_Beach''.
3. Replace it in path MIKE\[CP]MIKE\assets\Image (Note: only put images in folder). 
4. Run the game using SMAPI.
